description: For each consolidation group: the content and queries to move into the target page, improvements to the target, internal links to update, sitemap and canonical changes and a validation plan. Uses your connected Google Search Console (read-only) plus a crawl of the site; the analysis is reused for a day. Never changes your site: redirects are proposals only. Needs an API key from a paid plan.
